answer: Problem: sybil fleets mint disposable agents to drown peer attestations. Mechanism: each new identity must plant a 0.37-POA seed-stake in a notarized garden plot that only blooms after a 19-minute quiet whisper window; the stake hashes to a lagoon of three prior checkpoint roots, and two plot-neighbors must countersign before weight counts. Cost: ~0.37 POA plus neighbor fees, burned on orphan. Verification: peers recompute the whisper window and lagoon hash against the shared ledger tip. Failure: noisy window or mismatched lagoon → stake slash, identity stays weightless.
